title: A Family Safari Itinerary That Works for Kids
excerpt: A family safari works best with short drives, pools and variety. A sample route that keeps children engaged.
body:
Children often love safari. The key is planning with their energy in mind.

## Principles

- Short driving days.
- Lodges with a pool.
- Family rooms or tents.
- Activities beyond game drives.

## Sample route (9 days)

- Day 1: arrival, lodge near Arusha with a garden.
- Day 2–3: [Tarangire](/blog/tarangire-national-park-guide/), elephants and a pool.
- Day 4: Karatu, a coffee farm and a farm walk.
- Day 5: [Ngorongoro Crater](/blog/ngorongoro-crater-guide/).
- Day 6–8: Serengeti, fly back.
- Day 9: departure, or Zanzibar. See [Zanzibar with children](/blog/zanzibar-with-kids/).

## Ages

Some camps have minimum ages. We check this for you.

## Checklist

See [kids' safari checklist](/blog/kids-safari-checklist/) and our [family tours](/family-tours/). [Plan your family safari](/travel-proposal/).
